newsitem.title: FINLAND: Construction, forest industry boost Finnish Q4 GDP.
newsitem.headline: Construction, forest industry boost Finnish Q4 GDP.

text.p: Construction output rose over 16 percent and forest and paper industry output increased 11 percent, boosting Finnish GDP growth to 5.8 percent year-on-year in the final quarter of 1996, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Friday.
SF revised full-year 1996 GDP growth to 3.3 percent from its preliminary 3.2 percent estimate.
Exports picked up towards the end of 1996 and showed over 10 percent year-on-year growth in the final quarter.
Imports grew almost seven percent from the year-ago period.
Private consumption increased four percent in Q4, with the biggest demand in durable consumer goods and services, SF said.
Gross income grew almost six percent in October-December from the year-ago period, it said.
